'''Kevin Secord''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[July 2001 Meriden tournament]] on 14 July 2001 with EBO with A New Secret Base, according to Keith Henderson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2672">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-20-meriden-ct-7-14-01-cpa-auditd2672/ meriden-ct-7-14-01-cpa-audit], DeckTech (Keith "Tessek-CPA" Henderson, 20 July 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-07-20-meriden-ct-7-14-01-cpa-auditd2672/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
